turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What features would most improve your workflow?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Emotion tags in the API — being able to say 'whisper this' or 'shout this' inline instead of generating separate voice presets for each emotional tone. Right now we manage a dozen presets per character.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is that a blocker or a nice-to-have?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nice-to-have for now, but as our character roster grows it's becoming a real maintenance burden.
